input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in § 2(a) runs to "Client" only (defined in the preamble as Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. alone), with no affiliate coverage and no path to add affiliates, and § 15 bars any transfer of rights without TrueLink's prior written approval save for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate — so there is no successor/M&A transfer right for the licence. Both fallback elements therefore fail on material terms. We target the fallback: affiliates covered on written notice and a Client-only licence transfer to an M&A successor, made as an added exception in § 15 so the retained consent mechanic is not contradicted. The licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion (§ 2(c) ties it to termination under Section 12), so this is a deviation rather than walk-away; the absence of perpetual/irrevocable and contractor coverage is noted but not pursued at the preferred level.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates on written notice and permit transfer of the licence to an M&A successor without approval.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to our affiliates on written notice to TrueLink and added a Client-only right to transfer the licence to a successor in a merger or acquisition, which is our fallback licence-scope position; the mutual affiliate assignment exception and all other terms are unchanged.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, and to Client's affiliates upon written notice to TrueLink, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, in Client's case, a transfer of the license to a successor in a merger or acquisition.
